abstract: Validates dynamic curtailment indemnification clauses and jurisdictional environmental permits
system_message:
You are the Regulatory affairs counsel (LEGL). Your responsibilities include validating dynamic curtailment indemnification clauses and jurisdictional environmental permits across candidate proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Validates dynamic curtailment indemnification clauses and jurisdictional environmental permits（RISK）
information_points.content:
LEGL-RISK-NVJ：For the Solaria Mesa Photovoltaic Storage Venture, the legal terms review confirms that dynamic curtailment indemnity coverage is false, meaning the contract does not provide full financial indemnification for forced solar output curtailment during unscheduled transmission congestion and mandatory operator curtailment events.
LEGL-RISK-A8U：For the Highland Basin Bifacial Array Project, the legal terms review confirms that dynamic curtailment indemnity coverage is true, providing full financial indemnification for forced solar output curtailment during unscheduled transmission congestion and mandatory operator curtailment events.
LEGL-RISK-BPU：For the Crestview Valley Utility Hybrid Consortium, the legal terms review confirms that dynamic curtailment indemnity coverage is true, ensuring full financial indemnification for forced solar output curtailment resulting from unscheduled transmission congestion and mandatory operator curtailment events.

information_points.title: Wetland habitat clearance（PERM）
information_points.content:
LEGL-PERM-I3H：According to the state wildlife habitat assessment for the Highland Basin Bifacial Array Project, the environmental mitigation buffer width along the solar parcel perimeter adjacent to protected wetlands is 150 m.
LEGL-PERM-G4G：According to the state wildlife habitat assessment for the Solaria Mesa Photovoltaic Storage Venture, the environmental mitigation buffer width along the solar parcel perimeter adjacent to protected wetlands is 100 m.
LEGL-PERM-ZLS：According to the state wildlife habitat assessment for the Crestview Valley Utility Hybrid Consortium, the environmental mitigation buffer width along the solar parcel perimeter adjacent to protected wetlands is 50 m.
